name: 圆曲线中点弦垂距计算器

map.由半径与转角求中弦垂距: Middle Ordinate from Radius and Deflection Angle
map.输入圆曲线半径 R 与转角 Δ（度），求中点垂距。: Enter circular-curve radius R and deflection angle Δ (degrees) to obtain the middle ordinate.
map.📖 查看「由半径与转角求中弦垂距 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Middle Ordinate from Radius and Deflection Angle User Guide"
map.由半径转角算中点弦 M。: Compute middle ordinate M from radius and deflection angle.
map.R=200m、Δ=60° → M=R(1−cos(Δ/2))=200×(1−co: R=200 m, Δ=60° → M = R(1−cos(Δ/2)) = 200×(1−cos30°) = 200×0.13397 ≈ 26.8 m, i.e. the perpendicular distance from intersection to curve midpoint.
map.由 JD 沿分角线量 E 得曲线中点 QZ，或量 M 校验，与 T/L 配套。: From JD measure E along the bisector to the curve midpoint QZ, or measure M to verify, together with T/L.
map.M=R(1−cos(Δ/2))，Δ 越大 M 越大，反映曲线越弯。: M = R(1−cos(Δ/2)); larger Δ gives larger M, reflecting a sharper curve.
map.E 和 M 区别？: What is the difference between E and M?
map.E 是交点到 QZ 的斜距（沿分角线）、M 是垂距，E>M 因含切向分量。: E is the slant distance from JD to QZ (along the bisector), M is the perpendicular; E > M because it includes a tangential component.
